<div class="content-page">

<div class="page-header fade-in">
  <h1 class="page-title">Software</h1>
  <div class="page-line" style="width:50px;height:3px;background:#d4a039;margin:0 auto;border-radius:2px;"></div>
</div>

<h2 class="section-label fade-in">R packages</h2>

<div class="pkg-grid">

  <!-- causalQual -->
  <div class="pkg-card fade-in">
    <div class="pkg-card-header">
      <div class="pkg-card-logo">
        <a href="https://riccardo-df.github.io/causalQual/">
          <img src="assets/images/causalQual-logo.svg" alt="causalQual logo">
        </a>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="pkg-card-name">causalQual</div>
        <div class="pkg-card-subtitle">Causal inference for qualitative outcomes</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="pkg-card-desc">
      Your treatment reshaped how people rank their health, satisfaction, or job quality&mdash;but standard methods pretend the outcome is a number. causalQual gives you sharp, interpretable causal effects on every category of a qualitative outcome, plugging straight into IV, RDD, and DiD designs you already know.
    </div>
    <div class="pkg-card-actions">
      <a class="btn btn-code" href="https://riccardo-df.github.io/causalQual/">Website</a>
      <a class="btn btn-paper" href="https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/causalQual/index.html">CRAN</a>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- valiCATE -->
  <div class="pkg-card fade-in">
    <div class="pkg-card-header">
      <div class="pkg-card-logo">
        <a href="https://riccardo-df.github.io/valiCATE/">
          <img src="assets/images/valiCATE-logo.svg" alt="valiCATE logo">
        </a>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="pkg-card-name">valiCATE</div>
        <div class="pkg-card-subtitle">Validation of CATE models</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="pkg-card-desc">
      You estimated heterogeneous treatment effects&mdash;but can you trust them? valiCATE stress-tests any CATE model with best linear prediction, sorted group ATEs, and rank-weighted ATEs, so you know whether your personalized effects are signal or noise.
    </div>
    <div class="pkg-card-actions">
      <a class="btn btn-code" href="https://riccardo-df.github.io/valiCATE/">Website</a>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ocf -->
  <div class="pkg-card fade-in">
    <div class="pkg-card-header">
      <div class="pkg-card-logo">
        <a href="https://riccardo-df.github.io/ocf/">
          <img src="assets/images/ocf-logo.svg" alt="ocf logo">
        </a>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="pkg-card-name">ocf</div>
        <div class="pkg-card-subtitle">Ordered correlation forest</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="pkg-card-desc">
      Stop forcing ordered outcomes into logit or probit boxes. ocf is a random forest tailor-made for ordered categories&mdash;delivering predictions and marginal effects with valid confidence intervals out of the box.
    </div>
    <div class="pkg-card-actions">
      <a class="btn btn-code" href="https://riccardo-df.github.io/ocf/">Website</a>
      <a class="btn btn-paper" href="https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/ocf/index.html">CRAN</a>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- aggTrees -->
  <div class="pkg-card fade-in">
    <div class="pkg-card-header">
      <div class="pkg-card-logo">
        <a href="https://riccardo-df.github.io/aggTrees/">
          <img src="assets/images/aggTrees-logo.svg" alt="aggTrees logo">
        </a>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="pkg-card-name">aggTrees</div>
        <div class="pkg-card-subtitle">Aggregation trees</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="pkg-card-desc">
      Who benefits most from a policy&mdash;and can you prove it? aggTrees automatically discovers the subgroups that matter, uses double machine learning for rigorous inference on each group's treatment effect, and lets you zoom from broad patterns to fine-grained heterogeneity without <em>p</em>-hacking.
    </div>
    <div class="pkg-card-actions">
      <a class="btn btn-code" href="https://riccardo-df.github.io/aggTrees/">Website</a>
      <a class="btn btn-paper" href="https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/aggTrees/index.html">CRAN</a>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>
